==Description==
'''Jack Frost''', internally referred to as the '''Trickster Elf''', is a support enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. It has average speed and high health. It has one ability where it will throw its block of ice at an enemy. This will apply [[Aggro]] to any enemy hit in its explosion radius of 5. This will not affect any '''Jack Frosts''' or [[Boss]] enemies. The '''Jack Frost''' will also not target [[Frost Ravager]]s, [[Frost Hunter]]s or [[Mega Frost Mystery|Mega Frost Mysteries]], though they can still get it if hit indirectly.

The '''Jack Frost''' is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy for majority of the time, though while it is using its ability, it will lose that attribute allowing other towers to attack it.

==Appearance==
'''Jack Frost''' has cyan blue skin and holds a transparent and cloudy ice block. It wears a grey and white mask over its eyes. On its head, it has white hair and cyan pointy ears. The cuffs of its coat are baby blue, and its wrists are covered by leathery brown guards. Its coat is primarily purple. On its shoulders, it wears protective guards as well. It wears a belt around its waist, with a crescent moon shaped buckle. Its leggings match the color of its coat. It has tall brown boots with metallic grey knee-pads.

==Strategy==
*While '''Jack Frost''' itself is quite weak, its main threat comes from its ability.
**It can apply [[Aggro]] to enemies, which will make towers target an enemy with it instead of the enemy they should with their targeting.
*High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] can be effective against it.
**You can also use the [[Saboteur]]'s ''Aggressive Toxins'' ability to make all towers target them, quickly killing them before they buff any enemy.
**Although some of these towers do not have hidden detection, they can still be used as while using its ability it will not be a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy. They will however still be less effective compared to towers with hidden detection.

==Trivia==
*'''Jack Frost''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]].
*'''Jack Frost's''' name is a reference to [[wp:Jack Frost|Jack Frost]], a snow elf originating from England.

==Update History==
*'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]
**'''Trickster Elf''' added.
**{{Bug}} '''Trickster Elf''' has a broken icon.
**{{Bug}} '''Trickster Elf's''' model does not load in the [[Index]].
**{{Bug}} When converted by the [[Hacker]], the '''Trickster Elf''' can apply [[Blessed]], [[Health Regen]] and [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] to towers. For [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], this being applied means the tower gains hidden detection.
*'''19 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0|v1.82.2]]a
**{{Bugfix}} '''Trickster Elf's''' model now loads in the [[Index]].
*'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]]
**Health decreased from 4,000 to 2,500 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] and [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode.
**Speed decreased from Slightly Slow (2.25) to Slow (1.7).
**[[Defense]] of 25% added.
**Cash given decreased from {{Money|5,000}} to {{Money|2,500}} on death.
**''Subzero Tricks'' ability changed.
***No longer gives [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Health Regen]] to enemies.
***Now gives [[Nimble]] to enemies.
***Explosion radius decreased from 7.5 to 6.5.
*'''28 August 2026''' - [[v2.8.0]]
**First wave appearance changed from 29 to 35.
**Name changed from ''Trickster Elf'' to ''Jack Frost''.
**Health increased from 2,500 to 45,000.
**Cash given changed from {{Money|2,500}} on death to {{Money|2,700}} every 10% health lost.
**Speed increased from Slow (1.7) to Average (3.25).
**Now is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy.
**[[Defense]] removed.
**''Subzero Tricks'' ability changed.
***Now applies [[Aggro]] to enemies.
***No longer applies [[Blessed]] and [[Nimble]] to enemies.
***Now loses [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] for 4 seconds while performing this ability.
***Explosion radius decreased from 6.5 to 5.
***Cooldown increased from 8 to 9.
***No longer targets the [[Frost Ravager]], [[Frost Hunter]] or [[Mega Frost Mystery]].
***Now targets the [[Fallen King]], [[Awakened Fallen King]], [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]], [[Fallen Seraph]], [[Fallen Angel]] and [[Fallen Shield]].
**Size increased.
